mapper.select: select sum(money) from user_money_details where user_id=#{userId} and classify=4 and type=2 and state=2 and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
select sum(money) from user_money_details where user_id=#{userId} and `type`=1 and (classify is null or classify!=3)

select * from ( select u.*, (select sum(money) from user_money_details where user_id=#{userId} and classify in (5,6) and by_user_id=u.user_id) as money from tb_user u where consortia_id=#{consortiaId} ) a order by money desc
select * from user_money_details where user_id=#{userId} and (classify!=3 or classify is null) order by create_time desc
select * from user_money_details where user_id=#{userId} and classify in (3,6) order by create_time desc

select ifnull(sum(money),0.00) from user_money_details where content='账户余额退款'
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')
select ifnull(sum(money),0.00) from user_money_details where user_id=#{userId} and classify=6
select ifnull(sum(money),0.00) from user_money_details where classify=7 and type=2

select ifnull(sum(money),0.00) from user_money_details where classify=#{classify}
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')
